name: Liferun
verdict: Liferun delivered 137 leads at a $16.08 CPL over the last 28 days, with the past 7 days showing healthy momentum as both spend (+11.18%) and leads (+11.11%) grew nearly in lockstep, keeping CPL virtually flat (+0.06%). The biggest movement is Google Ads spend surging 18.69% week-over-week, likely driven by increased budget allocation to the top campaign "BWS - July - Call Campaign" ($559.80 spend), though zero conversions recorded on Google Ads suggests all 137 leads are attributable to Meta, which warrants a conversion tracking audit on the Google side.

performance.verdict: Meta drives all 137 leads; Google's $527 spend produces zero conversions — confirmed leak.

findings.text: Google Ads consumed $527.29 over 28 days with 0 conversions recorded — every one of 137 leads traces to Meta. Confirmed cross-channel leak.
5 overdue SOW milestones (oldest: Stripe QA Jul 20): GHL gaps, end-to-end stack re-test, paid landing pages, and UGC batch all unverified — scale blockers remain open.
GBP actions dropped -100% in the last 7 days (38 actions in 28d window, 0 in past 7d) — organic discovery channel has gone dark this week.
3-day lead signal (Sep 7–9): 6+10+12 = 28 leads vs prior 3 days (Sep 4–6): 5+0+0 = 5 leads. Short-term Meta momentum is accelerating, not fatiguing.
GHL shows 182 contacts but only 120 opportunities created and 0 won — 62 contacts never became opportunities, suggesting an intake mapping gap, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads conversion tracking; $527.29 spent with 0 conversions confirmed — fix pixel or pause channel pending verification.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $527.29 over 28 days with zero conversions recorded while Meta delivered all 137 leads — this is a confirmed spend leak. The immediate action is to audit the Google Ads conversion pixel on the landing page and confirm whether call conversions are firing; if the pixel is broken or absent, pause Google spend until tracking is verified. Success is confirmed when at least one conversion event is recorded in Google Ads matching a known lead within 7 days. Re-check by 2026-09-17.

suggestions.text: Raise Meta daily budget by +15% (~$13/day from current ~$85/day) on strength of 28-lead 3-day signal.
suggestions.monday_update: The last 3 days (Sep 7–9) produced 28 leads vs 5 leads in the prior 3 days — a confirmed acceleration at a stable CPL of ~$16.08. Raise the Meta daily budget by approximately +15% (from ~$85/day blended to ~$98/day). Do not redirect Google budget here until the Google tracking audit (S1) resolves. Confirm the CPL holds at or below $18 within 7 days; if CPL breaches $18, revert the increase. Re-check by 2026-09-17.

suggestions.text: Investigate GHL intake: 62 contacts have no opportunity — confirm whether BWS duplicate check or field-mapping gap is causing the drop.
suggestions.monday_update: 182 contacts exist in GHL but only 120 opportunities were created — 62 contacts (34%) have no pipeline record, which is a probable intake mapping failure flagged as an overdue SOW milestone (BWS duplicate check, due Aug 31). The action is to pull the 62 un-mapped contacts, identify which intake path they entered through, and confirm whether the BWS field-mapping or duplicate-check automation is the cause. Success is defined as ≤5% of new contacts missing an opportunity within the next 7-day window. Re-check by 2026-09-17.
